ideas.title: Minnesota's New Office of Inspector General: A Step Towards Transparency
ideas.description: Investigate the creation of Minnesota's Office of Inspector General and its impact on fraud detection and prevention in the state.
ideas.angle: Follow-up on the establishment of the Office of Inspector General and its early successes or challenges.
questions: What are the office's early successes?
How will it impact state transparency?
ideas.insight: The creation of the Office of Inspector General signals a significant shift towards transparency and accountability in Minnesota's government.

ideas.title: The Ripple Effect of Education Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Explore the implications of recent education fraud cases, including the HISD investigation, on students, parents, and the broader community.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the impact of education fraud on stakeholders.
questions: How does education fraud affect student outcomes?
What are the long-term consequences for the community?
ideas.insight: Education fraud cases like HISD's highlight the need for greater oversight and accountability in educational institutions.
